verse.verse_2: Has taught the Qur’an to His beloved Prophet (Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him).
verse.verse_3: Has created Prophet Mohammed (peace and blessings be upon him) as the soul of mankind.
verse.verse_4: Has taught him the knowledge of the past and the future.
verse.verse_5: The sun and the moon are scheduled.
verse.verse_6: And the plants and the trees prostrate (for Him).
verse.verse_7: And Allah has raised the sky; and He has set the balance.
verse.verse_8: In order that you may not corrupt the balance.
verse.verse_9: And establish the measures justly, nor decrease the due weight.
verse.verse_10: And He appointed the earth for the creatures.
verse.verse_11: In which are fruits, and covered dates.
verse.verse_12: And grain covered with husk, and fragrant flowers.
verse.verse_13: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_14: He created man from clay like that of earthenware.
verse.verse_15: And created jinn from the flame of fire.
verse.verse_16: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_17: Lord of both the Easts, and Lord of both the Wests!
verse.verse_18: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_19: He has set flowing two seas that appear to meet.
verse.verse_20: Whereas there is a barrier between them so they cannot encroach upon one another.
verse.verse_21: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_22: Pearls and coral-stone come forth from them.
verse.verse_23: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_24: To Him only belong the sailing ships, raised above the sea like hills.
verse.verse_25: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_26: For everything on the earth is extinction.
verse.verse_27: And everlasting is the Entity of your Lord, the Most Majestic and the Most Honourable.
verse.verse_28: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_29: All those who are in the heavens and the earth seek only from Him; every day is an enterprise for Him.
verse.verse_30: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_31: Disposing all works quickly We tend towards your account, O you two large groups!
verse.verse_32: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_33: O the groups of jinns and men, if you can cross the boundaries of the heavens and the earth, then cross them; wherever you may go, His is the kingdom!
verse.verse_34: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_35: Flames of smokeless fire and black smoke without flames, will be let loose on you, so you will not be able to retaliate.
verse.verse_36: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_37: And when the heaven will split, it will appear like a rose painted red.
verse.verse_38: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_39: On that day no sinner will be questioned about his sins, from men or from jinns.
verse.verse_40: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_41: The criminals will be recognised from their faces, so will be caught by their forelocks and feet, and thrown into hell.
verse.verse_42: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_43: This is hell, which the criminals deny.
verse.verse_44: They shall keep going back and forth between it and the extremely hot boiling water.
verse.verse_45: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_46: And for one who fears to stand before his Lord, are two Gardens.
verse.verse_47: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_49: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_50: In the two Gardens flow two springs.
verse.verse_51: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_52: In which are fruits of all kinds, each of two varieties.
verse.verse_53: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_54: Reclining upon thrones that are lined with brocade, with the fruit of both Gardens close enough to be picked from under.
verse.verse_55: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_56: Upon thrones are the women who do not gaze at men except their husbands, and before them, are untouched by any man or jinn.
verse.verse_57: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_58: They are like rubies and coral-stone.
verse.verse_59: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_60: What is the reward of virtue except virtue (in return)?
verse.verse_61: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_62: And besides them, there are two more Gardens.
verse.verse_63: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_64: Densely covered with foliage, appearing dark.
verse.verse_65: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_66: In the Gardens are two springs, overflowing with abundance.
verse.verse_67: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_68: In them are fruits (of all kinds), and dates and pomegranate.
verse.verse_69: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_70: In them are women of good behaviour and gorgeous faces.
verse.verse_71: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_72: They are houris (maidens of Paradise), hidden from view, in pavilions.
verse.verse_73: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_74: Untouched by any man or jinn, before them.
verse.verse_75: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_76: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful decorated carpets.
verse.verse_77: So O men and jinns! Which favour of your Lord will you deny?
verse.verse_78: Most Auspicious is the name of your Lord, the Most Majestic and the Most Honourable.
